description: This file defines the 'Evaluator' class responsible for running evaluation jobs, handling retries, logging progress, and saving evaluation results, including error handling and output management.

classes.name: Evaluator
classes.description: A class that manages the execution of evaluation tasks, including retry logic, progress reporting, and result storage.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the evaluation process on a list of results, manages progress reporting, and aggregates evaluated results.

methods.name: runJob
methods.description: Performs a single evaluation job with retry logic, handles exceptions, and determines overall severity.

methods.name: saveEvaluation
methods.description: Saves evaluation results to files if evaluation fails, including YAML and text outputs.
